Summary: Foundation
Description: Project setup, CI, accounts and online CRUD.

Summary: Offline data
Description: App and data work with no network; changes queue in an outbox.

Summary: Sync
Description: Push outbox, pull changes, safe retries, sync status.

Summary: Conflicts
Description: Detect and resolve conflicting edits from different devices.

Summary: Monitoring and quality
Description: Sync history, admin dashboard, load and durability testing.

Summary: US1 CI runs tests on every pull request
Description:
As a developer, I want CI to run tests on every pull request, so that broken code never reaches main.

Acceptance criteria:
- GitHub Actions runs lint and tests; failed checks block merge

Backlog ID: US1

Summary: US2 One-command local setup
Description:
As a developer, I want one-command local setup, so that anyone can run the project.

Acceptance criteria:
- npm install && npm start (or docker compose up) starts client, API and database

Backlog ID: US2

Summary: US3 Sign up and log in
Description:
As a user, I want to sign up and log in, so that my data is private.

Acceptance criteria:
- JWT issued on login; session survives 7 days offline; wrong password rejected

Backlog ID: US3

Summary: US4 Create, edit and delete records online
Description:
As a user, I want to create, edit and delete records online, so that I can manage my work.

Acceptance criteria:
- CRUD persists in the server database; validation errors shown

Backlog ID: US4

Summary: US5 Browse and search records
Description:
As a user, I want to browse and search my records, so that I find them fast.

Acceptance criteria:
- List with search and filter by status

Backlog ID: US5

Summary: US6 App opens with no internet
Description:
As a user, I want the app to open with no internet, so that I can always reach my work.

Acceptance criteria:
- App loads in airplane mode after one online visit (service worker)

Backlog ID: US6

Summary: US7 Create and edit records offline
Description:
As a user, I want to create and edit records offline, so that I never lose work.

Acceptance criteria:
- Changes saved to IndexedDB and still there after a page reload

Backlog ID: US7

Summary: US8 Queue offline changes in an outbox
Description:
As a user, I want my offline changes queued, so that they sync later.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each change adds one outbox entry in the same transaction as the record

Backlog ID: US8

Summary: US9 Show when I am offline
Description:
As a user, I want to see when I am offline, so that I know my state.

Acceptance criteria:
- Banner appears within 2 s of losing network

Backlog ID: US9

Summary: US10 Upload changes automatically on reconnect
Description:
As a user, I want changes to upload automatically on reconnect, so that I do not sync by hand.

Acceptance criteria:
- Outbox empties within 5 s of reconnect for 500 changes

Backlog ID: US10

Summary: US11 Receive changes from my other devices
Description:
As a user, I want changes from my other devices, so that every device matches.

Acceptance criteria:
- Pull applies all changes after the stored cursor, deletions included

Backlog ID: US11

Summary: US12 Safe retries with no duplicates
Description:
As a user, I want retries to be safe, so that I never get duplicates.

Acceptance criteria:
- Same batch sent 3 times creates each record once (idempotency key per operation)

Backlog ID: US12

Summary: US13 Show each record sync state
Description:
As a user, I want each record sync state shown, so that I know my data is safe.

Acceptance criteria:
- Badge shows Not synced, Synced, Conflict or Rejected

Backlog ID: US13

Summary: US14 Merge edits to different fields
Description:
As a user, I want edits to different fields merged, so that no work is overwritten.

Acceptance criteria:
- Two devices edit title and status; both survive

Backlog ID: US14

Summary: US15 Keep my edit if someone deleted the record
Description:
As a user, I want my edit kept if someone deleted the record, so that I do not lose it.

Acceptance criteria:
- Record restored and flagged for review

Backlog ID: US15

Summary: US16 Choose between conflicting versions
Description:
As a user, I want to choose between conflicting versions, so that important edits survive.

Acceptance criteria:
- Side-by-side screen; choose mine, theirs or combine

Backlog ID: US16

Summary: US17 List open conflicts
Description:
As a user, I want a list of open conflicts, so that none are forgotten.

Acceptance criteria:
- Count badge on the Conflicts tab; list links to the merge screen

Backlog ID: US17

Summary: US18 Sync now button and sync history
Description:
As a user, I want a Sync now button and history, so that I can check what synced.

Acceptance criteria:
- History shows last 50 syncs with counts

Backlog ID: US18

Summary: US19 Sync health dashboard for admins
Description:
As an admin, I want a sync-health dashboard, so that I spot failures.

Acceptance criteria:
- Devices, failure rate and conflict rate per day; admins only

Backlog ID: US19

Summary: US20 Load test the server
Description:
As a team, I want the server load-tested, so that we prove it scales.

Acceptance criteria:
- 200 devices push at once; p95 under 500 ms per batch recorded
